The Knowledge Claim Schema (knowledge.openie.dev) [T/M/S · unmetered]

Defines an unmetered 7-axis tritemporal claim tuple <V_t, T_t, R_t, G, S, C, P> (joules=null) while reconciling 6-kernel Lean 4.36.0 counts: 1,422 source decls alongside 12 open RCE draft theorems.

1/2 Tritemporal lineage & proof audit:
- Extends Snodgrass & Ahn (SIGMOD 1985) bitemporal SQL, W3C PROV-DM (2013) & Wikidata qualifiers [S]
- Separates 1,264 RCE source decls (5,393 constants; 12 Appendix F.9 Draft-0.9 items unproved), 58 lut-adapt, 45 CTA & 31 horizon theorems

2/2 Formal vs empirical scope:
- 6 independent Lean checkers in bwrap certify deductive validity from stated axioms — NOT physical sensor calibration
- No FreshQA/HotpotQA RAG benchmark was run on knowledge.openie.dev itself (calibration lives in lut-adapt LA-37)
- Unmetered
